newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Group forms for MAS unit 40 bln yen bond.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for MAS unit 40 bln yen bond.

text.p: A group has formed for Malaysia Airlines Capital (L) Ltd's five-year 40 billion yen euro-bond, arranger Daiwa Securities (HK) Ltd said on Tuesday.

The issue is guaranteed by Malaysian Airline System Berhad (MAS). The 2.55 percent bond due May 29, 2002 were issued at par. Fees are 17.5 basis points for combined management and underwriting, and 15 basis points for selling.
The bond is rated A-plus by Nippon Investors Service Inc.
Twelve financial institutions in addition to the arranger joined the deal.
Mitsui Trust, Nikko, Norinchukin and Yamaichi are co-lead managers.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Fuji, Industrial Bank of Japan, Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan, Merrill Lynch and Sumitomo are co-managers.
